scope: Reconcile the shared GTK2 scrollbar rule's unverified native states with existing GTK2 runtime and SR10.4 evidence.

normal_cells.scope: All four normal GTK2 15x15 stepper cells compared with live SR10.4/VUE; each matched 0/225 pixels. The smaller horizontal normal glyph was not reproduced.

gtk2_pressed_matrix.scope: GTK2 2.24.33 applies the 53-pixel light/shadow swap and restores release across all four directions; this is a GTK2 runtime check, not four direct held VUE captures.

down_reference_cycle.scope: The recorded SR10.4 down cycle supports normal/held/released GTK2 pixels. The newer live R434 press shows 37 visible matching pixels; 16 expected relief pixels are hidden under the cursor, so the current live comparison is partial.

hover.scope: GTK2/Xvfb hover behavior verified; direct VUE hover comparison remains unverified.

disabled.scope: GTK2 disabled asset composition verified; direct Xt/VUE insensitive appearance remains unverified.

latest_vm_state.scope: Guest framebuffer is black; VM is active, but verify.sh exit 4 blocks graphical input while the distinct Prancheta MAME is active.

gap_matrix.up_pressed: GTK2 runtime proof only; no direct held VUE capture.
gap_matrix.left_pressed: GTK2 runtime proof only; no direct held VUE capture.
gap_matrix.right_pressed: GTK2 runtime proof only; no direct held VUE capture.
gap_matrix.hover: GTK2 runtime proof only; no direct VUE hover capture.
gap_matrix.disabled: GTK2 asset/runtime proof only; no direct VUE insensitive capture.
gap_matrix.thumb_drag: No direct SR10.4 interaction measurement identified in the rule or reviewed receipts.
gap_matrix.down_pressed: Historical reference exists and current live press is partly observed; full current-capture comparison remains incomplete because the cursor occluded 16 of 53 changed pixels.
gap_matrix.normal_horizontal_geometry: Direct installed GTK2 versus live VUE comparison is 0/225 per R394; do not resize without a new measured discrepancy.

result: The current queue summary overstated the remaining work as only a horizontal held-arrow capture. The contract requires separate native evidence for six states; GTK2 runtime success cannot substitute for SR10.4/VUE evidence. No theme, user profile, application or VM was changed.
next: Keep I167 on GTK2. Once the other MAME releases the guard and the VUE target is visible, prioritize a cursor-clear horizontal held capture, then close the remaining native states in the same scrollbar-family review. Do not infer hover, insensitive behavior or thumb drag from GTK2 alone.
